method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; the first encoding of the Regulations; the duty with a deadline (reg 12A(3)) is a regulative rule run inside the question (CONSIDER EVALTRACE ... WHEN FULFILLED); no exported question takes a DEONTIC or EVENT input; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation No. 131 (register id F2026C01012), compilation date 5 October 2026, includes amendments up to F2026L01167; retrieved 6 November 2026; today's text applied to every date (NOTES.md finding 12); Acts Interpretation Act 1901 s 36(1) item 6 and s 36(2) (Saturdays and Sundays only), applied by Legislation Act 2003 s 13(1)(a), from subjects/au/acts-interpretation-act-1901 and subjects/au/legislation-act-2003; Poisons Standard, Customs Act 1901, Customs (Prohibited Imports) Regulations 1956, TGA CMI templates, ICH GCP guideline and NHMRC National Statement not deposited (asked as facts)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run tgr-patient.l4 ; l4 run tgr-cases-patient.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: Medicines and biologicals as the patient meets them: reg 2 (immediate family, medicinal cannabis products), regs 9A, 9B with Schedule 10 Part 1 and Schedules 12, 13; reg 12(1)-(3) with Schedule 5 items 1 and 6 and Schedule 5A item 3 (paras (a), (c)-(h)); reg 12A; regs 12AB(2), 12AD; regs 12B(1), (1A), (1B), (1C) (tables asked as one fact), (2), (5), (6); 12BA(1)-(3); 12BB; 12C(1)-(3), (5). Out: the reg 12B tables' contents, treatment directions (12B(3), 12BA(4), 12C(4)), Schedule 5A item 3 fees and officer duties, reg 12AC, 12AA, 12AAB, Schedule 5B, other Schedule 5 and 5A items, Parts 2, 2C, 2CA, 2D, 2E, 2F, 3, 3A-3D, 4, 5, 5A, 6, 7, 8, 9, Schedules 1-4, 7, 8, 9, 9A, 14, 16
focus: medical negligence and health (claims work): consumer medicine information, unapproved medicines and informed consent, authorised prescribers, personal import and compounding, clinical trials
seat: the patient who has been given, prescribed, supplied, compounded, imported or trialled a medicine or biological
questions_exported: Must my medicine come with a consumer medicine information document
What fine can the sponsor face for supplying my medicine without the document
Does my consumer medicine information document meet the requirements
Must I be told my medicine was made using human embryos
Am I a Category A patient
Could I lawfully be given an unapproved medicine because my life was at risk
Was the statement about me sent in time
Can an authorised prescriber's authority cover my treatment
Did my doctor need an ethics committee's approval
Can a health practitioner supply me this medicine under the Minister's rules
What information about me goes to the regulator
Can I import this medicine for my own treatment
Is a medicine compounded for me exempt
Was my clinical trial run within the conditions
regulative_rules: reg 12A(3) -- the person who completed the statement must send a copy to the Secretary within 28 days after the medicine is given
